_meta.scope: Powell St between O'Farrell (S) and Sutter (N): west-side buildings in detail; east-side buildings that frame Powell sightlines. Coordinates WGS84 (OSM building centroids). Frontage/bay/height figures are estimates unless a source is cited. Street-address parity: odd = west side of Powell; on E-W streets even = north side (Post 3xx/4xx north side, Geary 2xx/3xx south side).

blockGeometry.note: SF downtown grid: 275 ft (83.8 m) Powell frontage per block, 412.5 ft (125.7 m) Geary/Post frontage per block. Confidence high for block dims; per-parcel splits are estimates (confidence low-medium).

buildings.name: The Westin St. Francis San Francisco on Union Square (St. Francis Hotel)
buildings.address: 335 Powell St (retail 301-345 Powell St; 427 Post St), San Francisco, CA 94102
buildings.corner: whole west side of Union Square: NW corner Powell & Geary (331 Powell) to SW corner Powell & Post (345 Powell)
buildings.yearBuilt: 1904 (two south wings, opened 1904-03-21; rebuilt after 1906 fire, reopened 1907); 1908 third wing; 1913 double-width north wing; 1972 Tower (construction 1969-71/72)
buildings.architect: Bliss & Faville (1904-1913, Landmark building); William L. Pereira & Associates (1972 Tower)
buildings.style: Restrained Renaissance/Sullivanesque commercial classicism ("free of Victorian or Beaux-Arts ornament" per landmark text) — rusticated stone base, plain shaft, ornamented attic frieze + heavy cornice
buildings.floors: 12 guest floors over 2-storey base (ground + mezzanine) plus attic frieze floor; Wikipedia counts 16 stories. Tower: 32 stories.
buildings.roofType: flat behind a heavy projecting verdigris-copper cornice with dentils; three pavilion roofs read as flat; tower flat with faceted crown
buildings.facadeMaterial: grey Colusa sandstone ashlar (rusticated at base); enamelled facing brick in courts (fire-damaged 1906); copper cornice (green patina); Tower: cream/beige precast concrete piers with dark bronze-tinted glass and rounded bay columns

frontageM.note: Powell = full block (high). Geary/Post frontages est. from OSM footprint: hotel parcel runs ~2/3 of the way to Mason (medium-low).

buildings.plan: E-plan seen from Union Square: three 12-storey pavilions (south 1904, centre 1904, north 1913 'double-width') project EAST toward Powell with two recessed light courts between them; a continuous 2-storey rusticated base with storefronts and the hotel entrance runs the full Powell frontage under the courts. The 32-storey 1972 Tower stands directly behind (west) the north/centre pavilions with exterior glass elevators on its east face visible from the square. Confidence: medium (photo analysis of refs 01/06/14 + Wikipedia wing description).
buildings.bayLayout: S pavilion 5 bays | court 3 bays | centre pavilion 5 bays | court 3 bays | N pavilion 7 bays (photo count, medium-low)
buildings.windowType: punched rectangular 1-over-1 sash, ~1.2 m x 2.2 m, paired in pavilions; small square attic windows in ornamented frieze band; balconettes on 11th floor; base: tall round-arched storefront openings (~4 m x 6 m) with fanlights
buildings.base: 2-storey rusticated Colusa sandstone base (ground + mezzanine, ~10 m) with round-arched storefront bays; balustraded balcony over the central entrance at mezzanine level with flagpoles
buildings.cornice: heavy projecting copper cornice, green patina, with modillions/dentils and a richly carved terra-cotta/stone frieze band beneath (roundels, garlands)
notableFeatures: Central Powell entrance: three round-arched openings with dark-red fabric canopies; balustraded balcony above flying US flag + hotel/red 'SF' crest flag (seasonal Pride flag)
Dark-red (maroon) dome-shaped fabric awnings over most Powell storefront arches; ornate globe lamp standards on the sidewalk
Taxi zone in front of entrance; cable-car tracks in Powell
1972 Tower behind with five exterior glass elevators on the east (square-facing) face; tower crown of faceted cylinders
Magneta master clock inside lobby (interior only)
$45M Landmark building renovation 2018
